zh: （古怪或少见的）混合物，调合物，调配品（尤指饮料或药物）
en: a strange or unusual mixture of things, especially drinks or medicines
ex: a concoction of cream and rum
奶油和朗姆酒调制的怪味饮料

zh: （尤指相关联的或有因果关系的事）同时发生的，伴随的，相伴的
en: happening at the same time as something else, especially because one thing is related to or causes the other
ex: an increase in student numbers and the concomitant increase in class size
学生人数增加，班级人数随之增加

en: peace and agreement
ex: living in concord with neighbouring states
与邻国和睦相处

zh: （书籍等中按字母顺序排列的）词语索引
en: an alphabetical list of the words used in a book, etc. showing where and how often they are used
ex: a Bible concordance
《圣经》用语索引

zh: （和某事物）相一致的，相吻合的
en: in agreement with something
ex: The findings are concordant with similar studies in other countries.
这些发现与其他国家的类似研究一致。

zh: （尤指罗马教廷与各国政府订立的）政教协定，政教条约
en: an agreement, especially between the Roman Catholic Church and the state

zh: （尤指机场或火车站的）大厅，广场
en: a large, open part of a public building, especially an airport or a train station
ex: the station concourse
车站大厅

zh: 确实的，具体的（而非想象或猜测的）
en: made of concrete
ex: a concrete floor
混凝土地面

zh: 混凝土丛林（指高楼林立、无树木无公园因而单调沉闷的现代化城市或地区）
en: a way of describing a city or an area that is unpleasant because it has many large modern buildings and few trees or parks
